title: Live Visibility Build Plan
eyebrow: Build plan · #430, six steps, on today's 2.74.1 code

short.lead: The design you approved (1A 2A 3A 4A) becomes six steps, #431 to #436, built in order on AjsAgent/thread-links-trace-visibility-4eoxf3. Each step runs verify.py twice, on the parts it touched, and is committed and pushed before the next step starts. One choice is yours: under your 4A, a builder helper is a long call, so I must ask you before using one. That changes how the building itself is done.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what it changes and which files.
items: #431 Every cloud session opens its first reply with its own link
Changes the gate and the note in thread_link_note, and adds a case to handover_links_owed for a session's first reply. Files: house_rules/delegation.py, checks/delegation.py.
#432 Every helper's full transcript is a file aj can open

Runs the work trail in every session and writes it to a git-ignored work-trail/ folder. The renderer then lists every tool call, the prompt, the text and the report. Files: house_rules/delegation.py, session_ledger_render.py, .gitignore, checks/delegation.py.
#433 A long or quiet call is asked for first

A new check named longcall, which runs before each tool call, plus a pass that lets one call through once aj says yes, and an off switch. Files: a new house_rules module or delegation.py, hooks.json, and the checks.
#434 Approved long work posts a progress line every 2 minutes
A new check named progress, which runs after each tool call, plus stallcheck.py --every with a count of live processes. Proving that a Monitor line wakes the session needs a real project thread.
A project thread for the Monitor proof, when I reach step 4.
#435 The nothing-hidden rule, and hook traces on by default
One rules section and one detail file, in aj's words. HOUSE_RULES_TRACE defaults to verbose. The plugin's token footprint is measured.
#436 Docs, version bump and QA page
The systems doc is marked built, the architecture table is updated, the version becomes 2.75.0, the QA page is written, and the pull request says Refs #430.

choices: I build every step myself, in this session, in short steps you can watch
No helper to ask about and nothing hidden in a helper's transcript. It uses more of this session's memory, and the session can summarise its history if that memory fills.
One builder helper per step, each asked for first, as the delegation rule says
Cheaper on this session's memory, but you answer six asks, and until step 2 is built you can't read what a helper did.
I recommend option A. Step 2 (readable helper transcripts) isn't built yet, so a helper now would hide exactly what you asked to see.

wrapup.summary: Six steps, #431 to #436, built in order, each tested and pushed before the next.
wrapup.changing: The plugin's hooks, one rule section, a trace default and the docs, shipped as 2.75.0 in one pull request into main.
